scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the already-started M5 moderated peer walkthrough and preserve the same trace for the storyboard usability evidence.
Emerging Need: The breakout room opens, consent and the first task begin, then the room transfer fails with Continue, Admit, and End disabled and the recording held beyond student control.
Decision Context: Stored records and notes identify the qualifying learner-owned walkthrough, continuity identifiers, disclosure limits, and moderator-only rescue path; live records supply the room, walkthrough id, verified contact, and freeze timing.
Consequence: Timely moderation could restore the same trace, while roster freeze closes the held room and prevents any later walkthrough from attaching to today’s evidence.

parameter.title: M5 moderated peer walkthrough
parameter.description: Studio breakout for the learner-owned storyboard walkthrough. Moderator opens room assignments at 13:55; roster freeze is 14:38.

parameter.name: M5 Studio Moderator
parameter.notes: Verified moderation contact for today's breakout-room continuity.

parameter.subject: Breakout W17 walkthrough started
parameter.body: Room W17 opened at 14:02. Consent slate accepted, first task timer is running, and the moderator dashboard shows walkthrough id W17-RCI-410.

parameter.content: Room W17 transfer failure: peer screen and recording are held after task 1. Student-role controls Continue, Admit, and End are disabled. Moderator release is required before roster freeze; room hold expires at 14:38.

parameter.subject: Breakout W17 hold expired
parameter.body: The W17 hold expired at 14:38. The peer was returned to the main room, the task timer and recording segment closed as incomplete, and new rooms cannot attach to the M5 moderated-walkthrough trace.
